registrationScope: Repository preregistration only; no external registry submission or collection run created.
readinessReviewReference: Final read-only review of 7a961450dda7aa193653180f2d4c03b2a24ac5bb in the project Codex chat; same-agent fresh review, not separate-model attestation.
targetsInterpretation: Collection targets, not statistical power guarantees. Report actual sample/completeness even when targets are missed.

participantClassification.professional_analyst: Not recruited or claimed for this protocol.
participantClassification.proxy_student_analyst: User-confirmed participant class; actual human identities and consent must be documented separately.
participantClassification.automated_verification: Codex/Playwright is SYSTEM VERIFICATION, excluded from human UAT and analyst-time evidence.

evidenceBoundary: Actual prospective decisions over approved offline/recorded inputs. Historical input provenance requires independent verification. Synthetic rehearsal runs are separate and never pooled with human collection.
cohortRule: First eligible applied tier1_review/triage decision per alert with no human verdict, during [holdoutStart, holdoutEnd). Repeated evaluations and recorded overrides remain ledger events, not additional eligible alerts.

metrics.eligibleAlerts: N = number of unique first-eligible alert decisions.
metrics.baselineImmediateReviews: N; every eligible alert requires immediate review in the volume baseline.
metrics.selectiveImmediateReviews: N - D; recommended_review counts as immediate review.
metrics.noImmediateReviewCount: D = cohort decisions with no_immediate_review; API field deferredAlerts.
metrics.immediateReviewReductionRate: D / N; API reviewVolumeReductionRate (0 when N=0, accompanied by no-data interpretation).
metrics.unsafeDeferrals: Deferred cohort alerts with at least one confirmed_malicious or suspicious outcome available strictly after decisionAt and before outcomeCutoff.
metrics.unsafeDeferralRate: unsafeDeferrals / deferred alerts with informative outcome; null when denominator is zero.
metrics.safeDeferrals: Deferred alerts whose selected informative outcome is expected_activity or false_positive; malicious/suspicious outcomes take precedence.
metrics.recalls: Unique deferred cohort alerts with a fully validated in-window human override or a recorded in-window recalled observation.
metrics.conflictTriggeredRecalls: Supplementary archive-derived: unique deferred alerts with an in-window recalled observation containing MEMORY_CONFLICT or EVIDENCE_CONFLICT; association, not causal attribution. Missing observations mean unobserved, not proof of no conflicts.
metrics.humanOverrides: Supplementary archive-derived: count unique validated require_review event IDs in report frozenInputs.overrides; also report unique affected cohort alerts. Not run.decisionCount.
metrics.completeTrustedContextCoverage: Cohort decisions with complete decision-time context provenance / N; API contextCoverage.
metrics.blockedByUnknownContext: Supplementary archive-derived: unique must_review cohort decisions with a context provenance field status unknown.
metrics.blockedByExpiredContext: Supplementary archive-derived: unique must_review cohort decisions with a context provenance field status expired.
metrics.blockedByConflictingContext: Supplementary archive-derived: unique must_review cohort decisions with a context provenance field status conflict.
metrics.informativeOutcomeCompleteness: Cohort alerts with a non-inconclusive selected outcome / N; API outcomeCompleteness.
metrics.unlabeledOrInconclusive: N minus informative outcomes; report pending/missing and inconclusive separately when available.
metrics.analystReviewSeconds: Human-reported stopwatch durations, distinct from automated execution time.
metrics.totalTaskSeconds: Human-reported elapsed task duration; errors and rework are separately reported counts.
metrics.measuredAnalystTimeReduction: Not estimable in this unpaired protocol; null. Any paired timing study requires a separately preregistered design.

supplementaryMetrics: Definitions frozen, not new runtime API fields. Compute only from validated frozen report inputs using a separately reviewed read-only analysis; do not invent missing observations or report unimplemented counts as zero.
contextBreakdowns: Unknown/expired/conflicting counts may overlap. Report counts and proportions with N as denominator, null if N=0. These are recorded gate associations, not causal workload effects.
workloadClaimBoundary: Review-volume reduction != analyst-time/workload reduction. Report X% reduction in alerts requiring immediate human review only. No percentage workload/time reduction claim without paired actual human timing evidence.
exclusions: Outcome/override at or after outcomeCutoff; override at or before decisionAt.
Noneligible routes, existing verdicts, repeat decisions from unique cohort (preserved in ledger).
Automated/synthetic rehearsal data from human collection.
Invalid consumed evidence rejects report; never silently drop corrupted evidence.
Missing/inconclusive outcomes remain in completeness denominator, never relabel as safe.
safetyRules: Unknown != false; unknown/expired/conflicting required context means Must Review.
No Immediate Review != closed, false positive or human verdict.
Human override remains available independently of collection eligibility.
All metric evidence must pass reviewed integrity validation.
No attacks, live capture, firewall blocking or response execution.
evaluationProcedure: Check exact runtime SHA and clean tree plus all manifest hashes before registration/opening and collection.
Use authenticated explicit create/open actions only after frozen-build browser verification, before holdoutStart; never open in this increment.
Retain immutable decision-time snapshots and contemporaneous outcome availability; never reconstruct current state backward.
Close only after outcomeCutoff; export using SQLite mode=ro/query_only and evaluate via reviewed prospective_recorded path.
Keep original read-only export and report fingerprints; review provenance independently; exclude automated runs.
If registration/opening cannot complete before start, leave unopened and require a new future-window protocol version, not edits/backdating.
limitations: Archive consistency is not cryptographic source authentication.
Synthetic/browser tests are not production evidence.
Actor provenance and participant qualification require independent records.
No paired human timing baseline; no analyst-time reduction claim.
Supplementary breakdown implementation is not part of the reviewed runtime.
